title: Session 6: The times
opening_question: Daniel and Revelation both name a time of trouble: "a time and times", forty and two months, 1,260 days. Where does each one stand, and what happens in that time?

steps.question: How long are the saints given into his hand?

facts.text: The word for "time" in Daniel 7:25 is iddan: "a set time; technically a year".

steps.question: What did the man clothed in linen swear, and how long shall it be?

facts.text: The word for "time" in Daniel 12:7 is moed: "an appointment that is a fixed time or season".

steps.question: How long is the woman nourished in the wilderness, in days and in times?

facts.text: Revelation 12 gives the stay in the wilderness two ways: "a thousand two hundred and threescore days" (12:6) and "a time, and times, and half a time" (12:14).
Daniel 7:25 has "a time and times"; Daniel 12:7 has "a time, times, and an half"; Revelation 12:14 has "a time, and times, and half a time".

steps.question: How long is the holy city trodden, how long do the two witnesses prophesy, and how long does the beast continue?

facts.text: "forty and two months" stands in Revelation 11:2 and 13:5; "a thousand two hundred and threescore days" in 11:3 and 12:6.

steps.question: The verses readers ask about most: what do Daniel 12:11-12 and 9:27 say, and where does the Bible count a day for a year?

facts.text: Daniel 12 names two more numbers: "a thousand two hundred and ninety days" and "the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days". Daniel 9:27: "in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease".

Numbers 14:34 and Ezekiel 4:6 count "each day for a year". Some read the 1,260 days of Daniel and Revelation as years for this reason; others read them as days. The text of Daniel and Revelation does not say which.

steps.question: Living it out: Jesus said "of that day and hour knoweth no man". What do these verses ask of us instead of counting?

facts.text: "It is not for you to know the times or the seasons", "But ye shall receive power"; "Watch therefore".

remember.text: Daniel hears "a time and times and the dividing of time" and "a time, times, and an half".
Revelation 12 gives the same stay two ways: "a thousand two hundred and threescore days" and "a time, and times, and half a time".
"forty and two months" stands in Revelation 11 and 13.
